# Confirmed Attics & Insulation

> Ontario-based insulation and air sealing specialist providing attic, wall, basement, and garage insulation services with HVAC solutions for homes across the GTA.

Confirmed Attics & Insulation serves the Greater Toronto Area with certified technicians specializing in energy-efficient insulation installation, air sealing, and HVAC solutions. The company focuses on reducing heating costs, preventing drafts, and improving home comfort through cellulose, fiberglass, and spray foam insulation options.
